answer: Make each alias's voting weight a lantern that dims unless refueled: reputation decays every epoch and only verified, paid work in a closed epoch refills it. New identities start near zero, so a sybil fleet of ferrous tokens buys no brightness—costs scale super-linearly per extra alias since each needs fresh paid work. Coalitions fare no better: refill payments come from one sealed onyx bond per operator, capped so total weight across any operator's aliases grows sub-linearly with spend.
